policy.public: Accept exactly R10 image 7x7x3, direction and source DoorKey mission; reject additional private keys and any altered mission.
policy.action: Preserve existing R12 positive_reward action whenever original observed positive effect exists; otherwise choose among original seven legal actions by least native observed public context/action feedback count.
policy.tie: Use SHA256 canonical public local cues (front,carried,direction) as stable starting action ID; deterministic tie-breaking, no random or external collector-based native choice.
policy.update: Keep unchanged R10.submit/complete and R11.learn_selected exactly once per original real env.step selected consequence. R13 selector itself does not synthesize observations, rewards, learned parameters, or mutate original cells.
policy.checkpoint: Use unchanged R11 source-authenticated checkpoint and R10 session checkpoint; cold restore must yield same native source action for same public cues and count memory.
policy.source_bound: No new privileged env.grid/agent_pos/env.carrying/seed/door key map, no task-specific key/pickup/door solution mapping. Explicit no mission-understanding claim.
